# Digital Technology Partner: full public-page guide

> This file summarises approved public information on digitaltechnologypartner.ai. The linked pages remain the authoritative source.

## Organisation and approach

Digital Technology Partner (DTP) helps leadership teams turn scattered AI activity into governed systems with measurable operational value. Its public site describes practical AI programmes and systems, an evidence-gated delivery process, anonymised case-study patterns, and commentary on AI adoption, governance and delivery.

- [Ecosystem index](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/): Interactive index linking DTP's main public sections.
- [Home](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/home/): Overview of DTP's position and routes through readiness, leadership support and delivery.
- [Why DTP](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/why-dtp/): DTP's stage-gated delivery approach, governance position and questions for evaluating an AI partner.
- [Solutions](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/solutions/): Problem-led work on dashboards, automation, AI agents and bespoke systems, delivered through staged gates.
- [Process](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/process/): Discover, Prove, Build, Pilot and Launch, including evidence requirements and stop decisions.
- [Contact](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/contact/): Public enquiry routes and what happens after a message is sent.

## Programmes

- [AI programmes](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/): Index to AI Adoption Readiness, AI Foundry and Leadership AI Coaching.
- [AI Adoption Readiness](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-adoption-readiness/): A one-week assessment of current AI use, risk, opportunity and practical next decisions.
- [AI Foundry](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-foundry/): A twelve-week working-group format for turning AI experiments into evidence and leadership choices.
- [Leadership AI Coaching](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/leadership-ai-coaching/): Private AI coaching for senior leaders covering concepts, decisions and strategic judgement.

## Evidence and editorial indexes

- [Case studies](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/case-studies/): Four anonymised delivery patterns organised around travel risk, workflow drag, visibility and missing capability.
- [Insights](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/insights/): DTP commentary on AI adoption, governance, delivery and leadership decisions.
- [Newsroom](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/news/): Index of public DTP articles on AI adoption, governance, delivery and automation.
